cases.why: Samsung galaxy s6 title opened prod.html?idp_=1 with name, $360 *includes tax, description and a green Add to cart button. Add to cart was only looked at, not clicked.

cases.why: New message popup opened with Contact Email:, Contact Name:, Message:; Close and Send message shown; footer Close closed it. Nothing typed, Send message not clicked.

cases.why: Log in popup showed empty Username: and Password: fields. Clicking Log in with empty fields gave the alert "Please fill out Username and Password.". Header still shows Log in.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] Log in with a wrong password shows "Wrong password."
cases.why: Typed {TEST_USERNAME} and the fake wrong-password value into the Log in popup and clicked Log in. Alert "Wrong password." shown; header still shows Log in.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] "Previous" goes back to the first page of products
cases.why: Step 6 answered No: after Next then Previous, the first product is Nokia lumia 1520, not Samsung galaxy s6. Samsung galaxy s6 is missing from the product list (page 1 shows Nokia lumia 1520, Nexus 6, Samsung galaxy s7, Iphone 6 32gb, Sony xperia z5, HTC One M9, Sony vaio i5, Sony vaio i7, Apple monitor 24). Stable after 3 seconds.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] Product images on page 2 open the product page
cases.why: Clicking the image of Apple monitor 24 on page 2 did not open the product page. The browser went to https://www.demoblaze.com/# and showed the home page (page 1) again.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] Unknown product shows a clear message instead of "undefined"
cases.why: Unknown product idp_=999 shows the text "undefined" as the product name, "$undefined" as the price and "undefined" as the description. No message says the product does not exist. The Add to cart button is visible.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] Tab title names the product on a product page
cases.why: On https://www.demoblaze.com/prod.html?idp_=1 the tab title is "STORE" and does not contain "Samsung galaxy s6". The product name is only in the page heading.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] Unknown page shows a friendly error with a way back
cases.why: https://www.demoblaze.com/this-page-does-not-exist shows a plain server 404 page "Error: Not Found" with no shop header and no link back to Home.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] Page response has the usual security headers
cases.why: The response of https://www.demoblaze.com/ has none of the security headers asked for: no Strict-Transport-Security, no Content-Security-Policy, no X-Frame-Options, no X-Content-Type-Options, no Referrer-Policy, no Permissions-Policy. The headers present are age, cache-control, content-encoding, content-length, content-type, date, etag, expires, server (Google Frontend) and x-cloud-trace-context.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] "Phones" shows 9 products
cases.why: Phones category shows 7 products, not 9: Samsung galaxy s6, Nokia lumia 1520, Nexus 6, Samsung galaxy s7, Iphone 6 32gb, Sony xperia z5, HTC One M9.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] First product on Home is "Nexus 6"
cases.why: First product on Home is "Samsung galaxy s6", not "Nexus 6". Nexus 6 is the third product.

cases.title: [LOGGED OUT] Header has a "Wishlist" link
cases.why: No Wishlist link in the header. Header links are Home, Contact, About us, Cart, Log in, Sign up. The word Wishlist does not appear anywhere on the page.
